title: GAP Insurance | Buy from dealer or Insurance company?
summary: A dealership F&I manager explains GAP insurance mechanics, cost, and why he recommends buying it from the dealer rather than an insurance company.

assertions.quote: some limit the coverage and i'm talking about the term the year the loan to value and if you have negative equity rolling over

verdicts.note: Reflects a real difference in typical GAP product designs, though specific limits vary by insurer, and dealer-sold GAP has its own exclusions too.

assertions.quote: if you're buying a new or used vehicle and don't have 20 down you need to buy it
are you willing to take the risk that the next insurance company is going to cover your gap coverage

verdicts.note: A real risk tied to GAP typically being underwritten per-insurer rather than attached to the vehicle or loan.

assertions.quote: i think that an insurance company that covers the gap coverage is kind of like a conflict of interest

verdicts.note: A rhetorical framing from one dealership F&I manager; conflict-of-interest claims about insurers aren't independently substantiated here.
